declaration.preface:
Anupam Rasayan India Limited (ARIL), established in 1984, is a leading manufacturer of life science–related specialty chemicals with a global reputation for innovation, reliability, and integrity. We firmly believe that long-term success and stakeholder trust are built on a foundation of ethical conduct, transparency, and accountability.

This Policy on Ethical Business Practices defines our unwavering commitment to conduct business responsibly and in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and international standards. It reinforces our core values of honesty, fairness, and respect in every decision and interaction — with employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and the community.

The policy aligns with the UN Global Compact Principles, OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, ISO 37001 Anti-Bribery Management System, and the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It serves as a guiding framework to uphold ethical governance, prevent misconduct, and promote a culture of integrity across all Anupam Rasayan operations.
declaration.declaration: Anupam Rasayan is committed to conducting all its business operations with integrity, fairness, and transparency. We uphold the highest ethical standards across our value chain and strive to ensure that all decisions, transactions, and relationships are guided by honesty, accountability, and compliance with applicable laws. Our ethical business commitments are defined under the following key focus areas:
declaration.scope:
This Policy on Ethical Business Practices applies to all directors, employees, contract workers, suppliers, distributors, agents, consultants, and third-party partners associated with Anupam Rasayan India Limited and its subsidiaries.

It covers all aspects of business conduct, including — but not limited to — corporate governance, procurement, sales, marketing, finance, human resources, research and development, and community engagement.

The policy ensures that every business transaction and stakeholder relationship is guided by the principles of transparency, fairness, accountability, and compliance with the highest standards of professional ethics. It applies equally across all operational units, including.

Corruption: Corruption: We maintain a zero-tolerance policy toward bribery, corruption, and any unethical means of obtaining business advantage. Employees and business partners are strictly prohibited from offering, giving, soliciting, or accepting bribes, gifts, or facilitation payments that could improperly influence business decisions. All transactions must comply with the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, Companies Act, 2013, and the ISO 37001: Anti-Bribery Management System standards. Training and awareness programs are conducted regularly to reinforce ethical conduct across all levels of the organization.
Fraud: Fraud: Anupam Rasayan enforces strict measures to detect, prevent, and respond to fraud or misrepresentation in any form. All employees are required to perform their duties with integrity and ensure the accuracy of company records, reports, and financial statements. Any act of deception, forgery, or manipulation of information is subject to immediate disciplinary action and potential legal consequences. Internal control systems and regular audits are maintained to safeguard against fraudulent behavior.
Conflict of Interest: Conflict of Interest: We expect all employees and directors to act in the best interest of the company and avoid situations where personal interests may conflict with professional duties. Any potential or perceived conflict, including financial interests in competitors, suppliers, or customers, must be promptly disclosed to the Ethics and Compliance Committee. Decisions must always be objective, transparent, and aligned with the company’s ethical values and reputation.
Responsible Information Management: Responsible Information Management: We are committed to protecting the confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity of all information entrusted to us. Employees and business partners must handle proprietary, customer, and employee data responsibly and in compliance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and relevant data protection laws. Sharing of confidential information is permitted only for legitimate business purposes and with proper authorization. Misuse, unauthorized disclosure, or mishandling of company or stakeholder information is strictly prohibited.
Anti-Competitive Practices: Anti-Competitive Practices: Anupam Rasayan promotes fair competition and responsible market behavior. The company strictly prohibits anti-competitive practices such as price-fixing, bid-rigging, collusion, or market manipulation. All business dealings must comply with the Competition Act, 2002, and international fair-trade principles. We believe in winning business through quality, innovation, and service excellence — never through unfair or unethical advantage.
Money Laundering: Money Laundering: We do not tolerate money laundering, terrorist financing, or any illegal financial activity. The company ensures that all financial transactions are transparent, legitimate, and fully traceable. Due diligence is conducted on customers, vendors, and business partners to prevent association with illegal or unethical activities. Employees are required to immediately report any suspicious transactions to the Compliance Department, in accordance with the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002.
Whistleblower Protection: Whistleblower Protection: Anupam Rasayan encourages all employees, suppliers, and stakeholders to report any unethical conduct, violation of laws, or breach of this policy without fear of retaliation. The company’s Whistleblower Policy ensures that all reports are handled confidentially and investigated promptly by the Ethics and Compliance Committee. Whistleblowers are protected against discrimination, dismissal, or any adverse consequence for reporting in good faith.

policy.reviewMechanism:
The Sustainability Committee, in coordination with the Ethics and Compliance Committee, Internal Audit, and Legal Departments, shall be responsible for conducting the annual review of this Policy on Ethical Business Practices. The review will evaluate the policy’s effectiveness, compliance performance, and progress toward established ethical and governance targets.

The review will also assess outcomes of risk assessments, audit results, whistleblower cases, and any significant changes in applicable laws, regulations, or industry standards. Based on these evaluations, recommendations for updates or corrective measures will be submitted to the Board of Directors for approval.

Any revisions, amendments, or enhancements to this policy arising from new regulatory requirements, audit findings, or stakeholder feedback will be formally approved by the Board of Directors and communicated across all operational sites and value chain partners. This ensures continued alignment with Anupam Rasayan’s values of transparency, integrity, and responsible business conduct.
